scope: Postprocessing the 10 existing Experiment3 JSON files only; no simulations, new trajectories, channel evolution, stationary solve, or exact-reference computation.

method.maximum_errors: all saved preparations, time nodes, sites/bonds
method.quadrature: trapezoidal integration of squared errors saved at native nodes; approximate between nodes
method.uncertainty: 2SE is descriptive pointwise coverage; no simultaneous confidence guarantee; shared preparations/time points are correlated
